problems: Four of the five dossiers (sulayhid-dynasty, najahid-dynasty, uyunid-emirate, zurayid-dynasty) were already repaired on 2026-10-20 by an earlier pass of this same job (their notes carry 'Review repair'), which was cut off before ghaznavid-empire, me-08-e.md and the report. This run checked each of the 13 listed fixes against the dossier and the re-opened pages (Ali al-Sulayhi, Najahid dynasty, Zurayids, Uyunid dynasty: all quoted sentences confirmed), repaired ghaznavid-empire (5 fixes), and re-validated all five with --resolve (0 errors). fixes_applied counts all 13 (5 this run, 8 verified from the earlier pass).

Request to sa-04 (ghurid-dynasty, starts 1152): ghaznavid-empire's 1148-1152 contest over Ghazni and Zabulistan (/ledger/31-32) names ghurid-dynasty although its life starts in 1152; start the dossier at 1148-1150 (Sayf al-Din Suri, Ala al-Din Husayn) or record the matching contest, and add the matching gain of Zamindawar, Bust and Bamiyan (Ghurid page: Ala al-Din Husayn, after two years' captivity from 1152 and before his death in 1161; ghaznavid-empire places the loss at 1161, confidence 1). The 1011 and 1060 Ghur events now use the free-text counterpart 'Ghur chiefs (Shansabanids)'.

Disagreement with the reviewer: the review put the Ghurid taking of Bust and Zamindawar in the 1150-1151 campaign; the Ghurid page has that campaign sack Bust's Ghaznavid fortresses and burn Ghazni (restored to Bahram by the Seljuks) and puts the conquests of Zamindawar, Bust and Bamiyan in the rest of Ala al-Din Husayn's reign after the 1152 captivity, so the loss is dated 1161.

Cross-dossier mirrors still open in other groups (unchanged from the review): kakuyids lacks the Ray events of 1030, 1033 (new Ghaznavid regain) and 1037/8 and the Jibal loss of January 1030; emirate-of-multan should carry the undated Qarmatian regain of Multan from the Ghaznavids; sulayhid-dynasty's 1138 dissolve hands the Ibb highlands to zurayid-dynasty while the Zurayid gain is c. 1148.

Remaining weakness: the 1152 Ghaznavid keyframe (1.2 million km2 less the Iranian cells) is wider than any page supports for 1152-1160; only the Iranian cells and the lands the pages say were lost are cut.

Page that would not load: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Farrukhzad_of_Ghazni (url_not_found). The Wikipedia Ghaznavids rulers table is garbled for 1041-1059, so only Mawdud (his page), Shirzad and Arslan-Shah were added to identity.rulers.
